atoms.exact_source_text: Guest Citizens are how MEDIAN turns ecological variety into hospitality and hospitality into attachment.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guest Citizens are the mechanism by which MEDIAN converts ecological variety into hospitality and hospitality into attachment.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Core species defines the Colony's civilizational shape.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Core species defines the Colony's civilizational shape.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Guest arrives with another body, another way of reading the world, and another set of needs.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Guest arrives with a distinct body, a distinct way of reading the world, and a distinct set of needs.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony learns those needs, builds a visible Place for them, accepts the opportunity cost of their presence, and eventually experiences their ordinary life through DWELL, MEET, Memory, and EMBODY.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony learns a Guest's needs, builds a visible Place for them, accepts the opportunity cost of their presence, and eventually experiences their ordinary life through the DWELL, MEET, Memory, and EMBODY systems.

atoms.exact_source_text: The two-type architecture keeps that promise tractable.
atoms.normalized_claim: The two-type Guest architecture keeps the stated promise tractable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Expedition Guests become individually consequential through shared Away systems and one bounded Permission.
atoms.normalized_claim: Expedition Guests become individually consequential via shared Away systems and one bounded Permission.

atoms.exact_source_text: Resident Guests remain fully realized at Home through one fixed civic Practice and one qualitative Affordance.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resident Guests remain fully realized at Home via one fixed civic Practice and one qualitative Affordance.

atoms.exact_source_text: Firefly and Bee demonstrate that a Citizen subject may occasionally be a known household rather than one body, while every other roster entry remains a particular individual.
atoms.normalized_claim: Firefly and Bee demonstrate that a Citizen subject may occasionally be a known household rather than a single body, while every other roster entry remains a particular individual.

atoms.exact_source_text: Expedition Guests give the party another way to meet the world.
atoms.normalized_claim: Expedition Guests give the party another way to meet the world.

atoms.exact_source_text: Resident Guests give the Colony another way to understand, protect, receive, and remember it.
atoms.normalized_claim: Resident Guests give the Colony another way to understand, protect, receive, and remember the world.
Neither Guest type is a module.

atoms.exact_source_text: Both are friends the Colony has made room to know.
atoms.normalized_claim: Both Guest types are friends the Colony has made room to know.
